name: Behind the scenery
description: Puts Mario behind the level's objects (like a vine climbed from behind) or back in front, by writing the priority of his graphics ($13F9: 0 in front, 1 behind objects; 1 also means behind a net). It holds only while the Piece runs, so use it in a block Mario keeps touching, as the Behind Vine block of the archive (SMWC 3948) does.
author: BlockCreator
